claude.performance_metric: Chapter 11 filing (May 2018); §363 sale of substantially all assets to PennEnergy Resources for $600.5mm; deregistered Nov 2018
claude.rationale: The slice documents a realized whole-entity insolvency trajectory: FY2017 net loss of ~$64.2mm, $21.4mm impairment, going-concern doubt, Chapter 11 on May 18, 2018, and a §363 sale of substantially all assets to a third-party operator with equity holders facing "little or no recovery." However, these facts describe financial distress and disposition without attributing the failure to any specific product/process interface disruption (p4) or any operations-versus-organization/culture fracture (p5). The slice provides no evidence identifying either interface as a driver, so both pathways are coded uncertain rather than 0, given the deep documented distress but absence of interface-specific detail.
